verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Google Cloud has event-driven mechanisms like Pub/Sub-based budget notifications and near-real-time push sync via customer-managed functions relaying change events, which are webhook-like patterns, but there is no direct documentation of a general-purpose webhook subscription API for AI-native consumption. missing for 10: explicit webhook subscription API/docs, examples of AI agents consuming these events, first-party 'subscribe via webhook' guide.
